stemMarkdown: In which year did the total number of students appearing rise over the previous year while the pass percentage fell?
solutionMarkdown:
Totals by year: 2021 220, 2022 270, 2023 280, 2024 340. Pass percentages: 2021 75%, 2022 80%, 2023 75%, 2024 85%.

- 2022: total up 220 to 270, but pass rate up 75 to 80 — no
- 2023: total up 270 to 280, pass rate down 80 to 75 — **yes**
- 2024: total up 280 to 340, pass rate up 75 to 85 — no

The answer is **2023**. In absolute terms 210 students passed in 2023 against 216 in 2022, so more people sat the exam and fewer passed it.
